source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne's NYM7 in Wappingers Falls is the only New York data center with a published megawatt figure, and that figure is 3 MW.

The facility publishes 3 MW of IT capacity and 100,000 square feet of technical space. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 3 MW is roughly 75 racks. That is small against the AI buildout, and the operator publishes no rack count, no accelerator count, and no tenant list, so actual deployment is not documented.

The only certification listed is SSAE 16 Type II, which covers audited controls for hosting services, not any specific AI workload. Nothing published here addresses liquid cooling, high-density power delivery, or the substation and interconnection arrangements that decide whether accelerators can run at a site. On the published record this is general colocation, and AI use of it is not documented.

New York's mapped footprint is 31 facilities, and NYM7's 3 MW is the entire published total for the state. Its first-place rank reflects how little is disclosed rather than how much is built. The data covers one operator's spec page and does not show the state's actual capacity, its grid constraints, or any tenant's compute.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
